title: Exponential backoff with jitter
summary: Implement capped exponential backoff and the full, equal and decorrelated jitter variants from AWS's "Exponential Backoff And Jitter", then a retry helper that retries only retryable errors.
hints: Every variant starts from the same window: min(cap, base * 2^attempt), with attempt counting from 0. Jitter only decides where inside (or around) that window the sleep lands.

rand() gives a number in [0, 1), so random_between(lo, hi) is lo + rand() * (hi - lo). Full jitter is [0, window), equal jitter is [window/2, window), decorrelated is [base, 3 * previous sleep), then capped.

retry loops attempt = 0 .. max_attempts - 1: return fn() on success; on an exception, re-raise it if it isn't retryable or this was the last attempt, otherwise call sleep(full_jitter(attempt, base, cap, rand)) and go round again.
